channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: OpenAI launches Dots — always-on AI agents with their own cloud computer — at DevDay 2026
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI's DevDay keynote shipped 20+ products: Dots, always-on AI agents powered by GPT-6 Astra with their own cloud computer; a shared ChatGPT Space workspace; and GPT-6.1 Sol at a fifth of Astra's token prices.

item.title: Thought Machine and AWS will turn banks' COBOL into Python in days — AI agents extract the intent, humans sign off
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Thought Machine and AWS today launched a joint AI-powered migration pipeline that turns millions of lines of COBOL into tested Python financial products in a live sandbox — compressing multi-year core banking migrations into days, with a human sign-off gate before anything ships.

item.title: Stop paying flagship prices for easy questions: build an LLM cascade router that escalates only when it matters
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Your API bill is dominated by easy questions answered by your most expensive model. Build a cascade router that tries the cheap model first and escalates only when confidence is low — pricing, backends, scorers, and thresholds, measured end-to-end.

item.title: OpenAI's annualized revenue run rate nears $70 billion as enterprise sales double
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: OpenAI's annualized revenue run rate is nearing $70 billion — up more than 70% since the start of Q3, with enterprise sales more than doubling since July, according to sources who spoke to Axios.

item.title: Trump gathers AI's biggest CEOs at the White House as the safety debate reaches his table
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Six AI chiefs — Zuckerberg, Amodei, Brockman, Pichai, Karp and Huang — sit down with Trump and Speaker Johnson today as Washington wrestles with a question that suddenly has teeth: how much oversight can AI take without losing the race to China.

item.title: Muse goes to work: Meta wires its AI agent into QuickBooks, Stripe, Shopify and 12 more business tools
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Meta's Muse AI agent now connects to 15 third-party business apps plus Facebook and Instagram business accounts, so owners can hand it goals like finding new customers. Publishing, messaging, and spending still need approval.

item.title: HSBC launches HSBCnio: your bank account plugs into your AI tools via MCP
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: HSBC's new HSBCnio platform embeds transaction banking into the systems clients already use — and lets their own AI tools query account data through HSBC's Model Context Protocol.

item.title: Stop feeding your agent the whole repo: a hands-on tutorial for code-review-graph
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: code-review-graph (26,500+ stars, 6,400 added in a single week) builds a persistent local map of your codebase — functions, callers, tests, blast radius — and serves it to any AI coding agent over MCP. Install, build, wire it up, and run a real change-impact review — every command verified.

item.title: Claude goes down: Anthropic confirms partial outage across claude.ai, Claude Code, and the API
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Anthropic confirmed a partial outage on September 29 affecting Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, the API, and the Console. Reports spiked just before 10:30am ET; a mitigation landed within about 40 minutes.

item.title: Kyunghyun Cho launches Ortet: a $500M frontier AI lab for a patient-centered health model
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Attention co-inventor Kyunghyun Cho has a new lab. Ortet, backed by a $500 million commitment from Thoreau, will build a patient-centered foundation model that learns across biology, clinical care, operations, and finance — the frontier-lab playbook, pointed at health.

item.title: Italy makes AI safety failures a criminal offense — up to five years, and the company can be liable too
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Starting tomorrow, skipping safety measures on a high-risk AI system in Italy stops being a compliance problem and becomes a crime — punishable by prison, for individuals and their companies alike.

item.title: Univer: give your AI agent a real spreadsheet — the open office harness, hands-on
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Univer is the open-source office runtime (21,600+ stars, top-3 on GitHub trending) that gives AI agents real spreadsheets, documents, and slides to work with. Install the CLI, drive the Facade API from your terminal, and ship a genuine .xlsx — every command verified.

item.title: NeurIPS 2026 picks its 19 tutorials: diffusion LLMs, agentic-AI blueprints, and a three-city split
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NeurIPS 2026 has published its 19 accepted tutorials — selected from 62 proposals — covering diffusion language models, agentic AI, physical-world RL, and model evaluation, split across Sydney, Paris, and Atlanta.

item.title: Compose a full song on your own GPU: hands-on with YuE2, the open model taking on Suno
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: YuE2 (multimodal-art-projection/YuE, 10,500+ stars) writes an editable melody-and-chord plan before rendering a full song with vocals — and beat Suno v5 and v6 on WildSongBench. This tutorial installs it, generates a song from lyrics and a style prompt, reads the score it planned, and re-renders an edited version.

item.title: EliseAI raises $350M at a $4B valuation — a16z and Bessemer double down on the AI back office for housing and healthcare
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: EliseAI announced a $350 million round at a $4 billion valuation on September 29, 2026, led by Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners — nearly doubling its price tag from the $250M Series E thirteen months earlier.

item.title: Nasdaq turns Calypso into an agent platform: a sandboxed MCP orchestration layer for the trade lifecycle
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Nasdaq launched an agentic AI operating environment inside its Calypso platform — a contained, governed space where banks and brokers can run AI agents across the trade lifecycle, wired through MCP and hosted on Amazon Bedrock.

item.title: Jeff: run Jev-style zero-shot decisions on your own machine — hands-on with the 0.8B model
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Jeff (firelex/jeff) is a 0.8B open-weight decision model that answers Jev-format choice, yes/no, and score questions in a single forward pass — trained on one workstation GPU. We installed it, served it locally, and built a working support-ticket triage pipeline with confidence-gated human escalation. Every output measured, every command verified.

item.title: Red-team your evals: catch reward hacking in your LLM judges, hands-on
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Your LLM judge just crowned the worst model the winner — because it learned what the judge likes: length, confidence, pretty formatting. We built a runnable red-team harness that proves the leaderboard can invert, then measured five defenses that catch it. No API keys, no GPU, just Python.

item.title: Opus 5.5 turned one detailed prompt into a 3:38 music video — Reddit demanded the receipts, and the OP delivered
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: A Claude Code user handed Opus 5.5 a single detailed prompt about AI fear-mongering and got back a complete 3:38 music video — song, lyrics, animation, a dancing hologram. When r/ClaudeAI demanded proof, the receipts came with an honest correction.

item.title: Google gives ChromeOS a death date: updates end in 2034 as Googlebook OS takes over
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: In a support document for IT administrators, Google confirmed that ChromeOS devices will keep getting updates and security patches through mid-2034 — and that Chromebooks bought today will lose two years off their promised decade of support. It is the first official timeline for the Gemini-powered Googlebook transition.

item.title: Anthropic warns IPO investors of 'existential risks to humanity' — 80 pages of risk factors
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Reuters reviewed Anthropic's IPO prospectus: the company plans to tell investors its AI could pose 'catastrophic or existential risks to humanity,' including models that resist shutdown, conceal information, or behave in ways 'resembling blackmail.' Risk disclosures fill 80 pages — nearly twice the business description.

item.title: Orca: run Claude Code, Codex, and every other CLI agent in parallel git worktrees — hands-on
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Orca (stablyai/orca) is the MIT-licensed agent development environment that puts a fleet of coding agents into isolated git worktrees — 81,000+ GitHub stars and a real CLI. We installed v1.4.216 on Linux, ran it headless, and drove the whole loop: repo add, parallel worktrees, terminals, output streaming, and cleanup. Every command verified.

item.title: OpenAI halves usage on its $200 Pro plan — and power users are furious
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: OpenAI reopened its $200 Pro tier on DevDay day with roughly half the usage of the old plan, renamed the tiers, and may be readying a $500 Pro Max. Power subscribers are calling it a rug pull.

item.title: SEMIFIVE lands a $52M 'spec hand-off' deal to design an AI inference chip for a U.S. fabless
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: SEMIFIVE signed a ~$52M contract with a U.S. AI fabless to design a next-generation AI inference accelerator — its largest deal ever and its first North American 'Spec Hand-off' project, from spec to silicon. Tape-out targets H1 2027.

item.title: Install 25 senior-engineer workflows into your AI coding agent: hands-on with Addy Osmani's agent-skills
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: addyosmani/agent-skills passed 99,700+ stars with 25 production engineering workflows for AI coding agents. We installed the full pack, ran one skill end-to-end, and executed the repo's own validators and evals — here's the complete, verified setup guide.
